The '''Valsedian system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]].<ref name="Atlas Companion" /> It contained the [[Valsedian asteroid belt]].<ref name="Valsedian Operation" />
